scoring_justification: Recompute dominant frequency from raw deflection time series and check structural trend of control effectiveness; frequency compared to paper graph reading.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold natural frequency for the specified configuration (PD-S, GPL-S, e0=0.3, Λ=1.0 wt%, h_c=10 mm, h_p=0.1 mm, PZT-G1195N, closed-circuit)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 9 (influence of porosity coefficient), digitized from published graph at e0=0.3
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from graph and rounded to 260 Hz
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from published figure in the referenced paper

outputs.description: First natural frequency of the simply supported piezoelectric FG metal foam plate for the specified configuration.

Time series of central deflection for uncontrolled (Gv0) and controlled (Gv0.01) cases under a step load. The checker recomputes peak deflection magnitude for each gain and verifies that the controlled response decays faster than the uncontrolled one.

output_contract.notes: The hidden gold for the natural frequency is the paper-reported value for the same configuration, compared with relative tolerance 1%. For the dynamic response, the checker extracts the peak deflection magnitude for each gain and compares to the paper's reference within 5% tolerance, and also checks the trend of faster decay with control.
